requestedIntent: Reduce Full BMAD execution time without removing independent semantic controls by eliminating model-driven bookkeeping, reusing only the story Developer session, and bounding reviewer context with raw hash-bound capsules.
limitations: V327-CAL-001 qualifies gpt-5.6-sol/medium only for Code Review. ATDD, Development, Patch Assurance, and Judge roles retain gpt-5.6-sol/high until role-specific evidence exists.

A review capsule is additive transport and cannot replace independent reviewer judgment or targeted reads needed to resolve a named uncertainty; a reviewer may rerun the focused command only for a named evidence conflict.

The runtime is enforced by schemas, writers, validators, tests, and installer wiring. The V3.27 post-red semantic-test defect now has a one-shot typed correction transition that resumes the original Developer, but the successor V3.28 live rehearsal and blind judgment have not yet proven it and target repositories have not yet been updated.
Existing Full runs with lifecycle evidence cannot adopt this runtime contract in place.
